I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision. It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included. It also says the decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions means no host is exempt.

The statement rests on two recorded decisions:
- **#22:** "verification on all builds". It replaced the earlier record that disabled verification in dev builds, so I left that older setting out.
- **#25:** "https everywhere, no exceptions". It replaced the earlier "plain http for internal hosts" note, which I also left out.

Muninn's session-start heartbeat reported RED: 20 hook runs started and never finished. I didn't investigate it. `muninn show` returned the records for #22 and #25 normally.
